entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to return an item. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical fault. The cadence tracking is completely inaccurate. One minute it says 90 RPM, the next it says 20. The thing is basically a piece of garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear that. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 17 days ago. For a defect claim like this, our first step is to run through some quick troubleshooting to verify the issue. It usually only takes a few minutes.

Look, I appreciate the offer, but I really don't have time for a tech support session. I've already tried restarting it and reconnecting it. I just want money back. Can we please just start the refund process?

I understand your frustration and your preference to move straight to a refund. However, our policy for the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns. Since you're on day 17 and are reporting a defect, we must first verify the fault before we can authorize a warranty replacement. Without that verification, the 10-day rule applies, and I'm unable to process a return for a refund.

Okay, I understand. I see your position. The 10-day window has passed, and you need to follow the rules. But I'm a long-time VeloFit customer, and I'm now stuck with a defective product. Is there any sort of compromise we can reach? Maybe a partial credit, or a discount code for my next order? I'm not trying to be difficult, but being out the full amount doesn't seem right.

I can see in your account that you are indeed a VIP member, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. You're right, and I want to make sure we find a fair solution for you. While I cannot authorize the refund per policy, given the circumstances and your status with us, I can offer you a $50 goodwill credit to your VeloFit account. You could use it towards a different product or any accessories in the future.
A fifty dollar credit? You know what, that's a fair offer. I appreciate you working with me on this instead of just saying no. I'll accept that. Thank you.

Of course. I'm glad we could land on a solution that works. I've just applied that $50 credit to your account. It's available for you to use immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
